The '''Custom Stop''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in [[Soco-Jarel Spaceport]]. Run by the hostess and [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Hhalyia Ahsane]], the bar was staffed by six [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]]. The drink prices were expensive, with the average price being between forty and fifty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. A stellar-class kitchen offeredlarge meals and could prepare almost anything a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] desired, including [[Alien/Legends|alien]] delicacies.<ref name="BSS" />

[[Gambling/Legends|Gambling]] was available at the Custom Stop as well, with games of chance including [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], [[Bounce]], and [[Qul'bukie Joker]]. Luxury suits were also available for the cost of between two hundred and fifty and five hundred credits a night.<ref name="BSS" />

[[Sordu Gogg]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] and "job doc" worked out of the Custom Stop. he matched [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to available work, ranging from legitimate cargo hauls to smuggling runs.<ref name="BSS" />
